procedural_matters: PUR 787 (49FX) was represented by Isabella Calzadilla (Helm).
The Race Committee was represented by Anne Malledant (PRO).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Race Q2 of the 49 FX was sailed using the ARMS system. The Whiskey flag was not displayed.
P flag was displayed as the preparatory signal for race Q2.
At the starting signal, ARMS identified PUR 787 as being on the course side of the starting line.
The unit onboard displayed OCS and flashed red for less than one second, and then the unit returned to its normal operation.
PUR 787 believed she was no longer OCS and continued sailing the race.
PUR 787 did not return to clear her OCS.
The Race Committee scored PUR 787 OCS for race Q2.
conclusions: PUR 787 was on the course side of the line at the start and failed to sail the course, breaking RRS 28.1.
PUR 787 did not knowingly break RRS 28.1 and fail take the appropriate penalty. PUR 787 did not break RRS 2.
